mentions.name: SiteSecurityScore
mentions.description: This website security scanner grades a site's security and tells you exactly what to fix, with a detailed breakdown of what's missing, step-by-step remediation guidance, and shareable report links. It scans HTTP headers, TLS/SSL, DNS security, cookies, and page content, and captures and reports CSP violations. Free to get started, with a REST API for integrating scans into CI/CD pipelines or monitoring.
